newsitem.title: USA: Italy Ciampi says CPI in 1.5 to 1.8/1.9 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Italy Ciampi says CPI in 1.5 to 1.8/1.9 pct range.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Saturday that consumer price inflation was now firmly in a range of 1.5 percent to 1.8/1.9 percent year-on-year.
"Inflation is now clearly in a range of 1.5 to 1.8/1.9 percent," Ciampi told reporters as he left to attend a meeting of Group of Seven finance ministers.
Economists estimated that Italian consumer prices would rise 1.5 percent year-on-year in June after the release of preliminary inflation data by five sample cities on Friday.
